The FLAT-collapse cause is settled by measurement, not hypothesis. Five candidates were tested in sequence: objective weights (V10, refuted), gradient clipping and learning rate (V11, refuted on bit-identical metrics), fusion amplitude (V12, refuted), specialist zero-init (V13, refuted on real data - the branch opens 0 to 0.236 to 0.328 within one epoch), and the balanced-sampler prior mismatch (V14, CONFIRMED). V14 produced the first admitted checkpoints since the 07-14 reset. The earlier optimization-throughput hypothesis recorded here is therefore withdrawn. V8, V9 and V10 remain immutable failure evidence.

V21C is the current empirical position: the first run with every repair in place at once, on the complete 369,303-row population. It overfits before it balances. Train loss falls 36% (89.41 to 57.16) while validation loss doubles (106.19 to 212.18) across eight epochs. Epoch 1 generalizes best and beats the 0.3858 majority baseline at 0.4048 accuracy but predicts zero SHORT and is correctly refused on class_support_ok=0; every epoch balanced enough to admit sits 4 to 5 points BELOW the baseline. There is no epoch that is both balanced and generalizing. The checkpoint monitor selects on dir_acc and therefore admitted epoch 8 at validation loss 212 over epoch 3 at 116; switching it to val_loss would not help, because the best-validation epoch is the degenerate one. V21C wrote no bundle and is immutable diagnostic evidence. V18 remains the only published bundle and is trainability evidence only.

The remaining diagnosis is capacity against available signal, and the gap is measured and small. Balanced accuracy is 0.3438 against a 0.3858 majority baseline and against 0.4021 from a plain unweighted-cross-entropy probe on the same substrate, which had all three classes alive and 0.5833 tradable AUC. A simple model achieves what the 22-head model cannot, so the substrate is not the constraint. weight_decay is 1e-05 and dropout is 0.05 for a model with 22 heads, eight specialist encoders and five timeframe branches. NO regularization magnitude is chosen: none is declared anywhere in the repository, so selecting one would be an invented magnitude (rule 2b). The legitimate routes are an explicit vedtak or a sweep that selects on validation loss. dropout is a model-class default with no CLI or recipe input and must become declarable before any sweep is possible.

Multi-timeframe coverage is 6 of 8 specialist domains, not 8. HTF V3 carries 90 per-bar features at every timeframe - V2's 25 plus 60 candlestick patterns and 5 swing/structure fields - verified bit-identical to V2 on the shared 25 and dense at every resolution (49-50 of 90). Trend, volatility, momentum, candlestick and swing are covered; SMC/liquidity and chart geometry are not, and both depend on one missing root: SMC primitives (BOS, CHoCH, sweeps) and S/R levels computed per resolution. Everything downstream is already a pure function of matrices and would run per resolution unchanged. Two hard limits remain: 513 field names cannot be shared across five resolutions, and D1 has 1,618 TRAIN bars so feature width must taper with bar count. The V3 cache is built and verified but nothing has trained on it.
